final_topology.title: Financial Data Ingestion Network
final_topology.description: A network designed for ingesting financial data feeds and processing them in dedicated market data pods before distributing to three campus sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network includes dedicated pods for data ingestion and processing, with each pod containing feed handlers, analytics workloads, and execution engines. The processed data is then distributed to three campus sites, each equipped with a switch and connected via trunk links for inter-site communication.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n_new5) that manages inventory for various nodes, indicating a detailed asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl_new1, nl_new2) and management links (e.g., nl_new18, nl_new19) that document data flows between different nodes and zones.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of data processing and storage, such as 'Ingestion Pod', 'Market Data Pod 1', 'Market Data Pod 2', and 'Non-Production Zone'.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n11, n12) that manage traffic to and from various servers and workloads.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes DNS servers (n13, n14) that are configured to manage DNS for various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5).

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n15) that manages MFA for various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS filter (n16) that manages DNS filtering for various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a web proxy (n17) that enforces URL filtering for various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7, z8, z9, z10, z11, z12, z13, z_new1, z_new2, z_new3) and links that segment and manage network traffic, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes secure network infrastructure components such as firewalls (n11, n12), DNS servers (n13, n14), and MFA server (n15) that are managed securely.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a central AAA server (n18) that manages authentication, authorization, and auditing for various nodes (e.g., n11, n12).

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN gateway (n_new2) and an AAA server (n18) that manage remote access and authentication.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes dedicated admin workstations (n24, n25) in the management zone (z7) that are segmented from the primary network and do not have internet access.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n19) that monitors traffic for intrusions.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n11, n12) that perform traffic filtering between different zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z8).

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n15) and a NAC (n22) that manage access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a flow log collector (n_new6) that collects network traffic flow logs from firewalls (n11, n12).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIPS (n20) that prevents intrusions.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NAC (n22) that deploys port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an application firewall (n23) that performs application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a non-production zone (z9) that is separate from production zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3).

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a pen testing zone (z13) with a pen test workstation (n26) and a pen test schedule manager (n_new7) that manage periodic external penetration tests.
